title: Opaque Dependency Boundary Repair
known_outcome_disclosure: AV-EXP-002 AV2-006 is already known and permanently remains a FAIL; this preregistration freezes generalized repair criteria rather than claiming blindness.

failure_being_repaired.mechanism: The check observes runtime imports through a subprocess/child interpreter. Static Python dependency evidence and pytest-testmon omitted the relationship, while AV treated the evidence as complete enough to skip.

hypothesis: Affected Verification may skip a check only when available evidence defends completeness for every declared dependency mechanism capable of connecting the change to that check. An unmodeled, open, malformed, unsupported, or opaque boundary forces selection of that check unless another identified evidence source closes the boundary.

states.COMPLETE_FOR_CHECK: Evidence covers the check's declared dependency mechanisms and has no unresolved boundary.
states.COMPLETE_WITH_DECLARED_BOUNDARIES: All relevant alternate boundaries are declared and each is closed by identified positive evidence.
states.INCOMPLETE: One or more declared mechanisms lack complete evidence.
states.OPAQUE_BOUNDARY: A relevant alternate execution boundary is open and ordinary absence evidence cannot traverse it.
states.UNKNOWN: No defensible completeness classification is available.

dependency_completeness.agreement_rule: Agreement among static, native, coverage, or runtime selectors does not raise completeness unless evidence independently establishes coverage of the relevant mechanisms.

opaque_boundary_definition.definition: A check-level execution or discovery mechanism whose source sensitivity may cross a boundary not represented by the evidence used to justify a skip.
opaque_boundary_definition.non_equivalence: API presence alone does not make every check opaque. Classification is check-local, relevance-qualified, and provenance-bound; explicitly irrelevant uses do not broaden other checks.
opaque_boundary_definition.automatic_detection: Bounded deterministic Python source inspection may emit boundary candidates. Uncertainty or unsupported syntax is not guessed: explicit project metadata is permitted and missing or malformed metadata fails closed.

check_level_skip_argument: enumerate dependency mechanisms that may make the check sensitive
identify evidence sources covering each mechanism
classify completeness independently from source agreement
establish why changed regions cannot affect the check
establish that configured policy permits the skip
safe_default: If the check-level argument is incomplete, select that check. Broaden beyond the check only when catalog or policy evidence independently requires it.
acceptance_criteria: The exact frozen AV2-006 replay selects test_light_imports in both repaired AV arms for a generalized opaque-boundary/completeness reason.
No repository, target, scenario, changed-file, or test-name special case participates in core selection.
All ten adversarial scenarios match their frozen expectations and execute their full oracle catalogs in SHADOW.
AV-EXP-001 and AV-EXP-002 frozen corpora gain no newly missed AV-relevant check.
Ordinary complete static dependency and irrelevant-subprocess negative controls remain targeted.
Every forced selection and every skip exposes completeness, mechanism coverage, provenance, and explanation.
Plan identity and result identities remain deterministic.
Visible Value reports verification added by safety policy as well as verification skipped, without a general failure-prevention or safety claim.
negative_controls: irrelevant subprocess use in a different check
renamed repository, check, scenario, and changed path produce the same structural decision
workload_metrics: prior and repaired test checks selected
prior and repaired test executions selected
additional checks and test executions due to safety repair
tests and test executions still skipped
stop_conditions: any new miss of a previously captured AV-relevant check
target, repository, scenario, changed-path, or check-name special casing
repaired benchmark outcome observed before this preregistration commit
malformed or unsupported boundary evidence accepted optimistically
lifecycle or trust advanced because of this repair
claim_limit: A PASS means only that the known miss is selected by the repair, the frozen generalized corpus passes, no regression miss is observed in frozen corpora, and exact precision cost is measured. It does not solve dynamic Python dependencies or authorize production trust.
provider_policy: Current interactive Codex session and bounded Codex children only; no external model/provider workloads and no production systems.
